subject.title: feat(nodes): add computer use (computer.act) on macOS nodes via Peekaboo

question: Should OpenClaw accept this built-in `computer`/`computer.act` macOS path after fixing explicit arming and live proof, or should desktop Computer Use stay plugin/provider-owned for now?
rationale: This PR crosses the desktop input and screenshot permission boundary and overlaps active Computer Use product/API design issues, so automation cannot choose the permanent ownership model safely.

options.title: Continue built-in macOS path
options.body: Require `/phone arm computer`-only semantics for desktop control, signed live proof, and explicit security approval before merge.

options.title: Redirect to plugin/provider design
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of #97333/#97938 if maintainers want Computer Use owned by provider/plugin contracts instead of a core built-in tool.

options.title: Accept all-group arming intentionally
options.body: Allow `/phone arm all` to include desktop control only if maintainers explicitly accept and document that compatibility and security-boundary expansion.

recommendation.title: Continue built-in macOS path
recommendation.body: Require `/phone arm computer`-only semantics for desktop control, signed live proof, and explicit security approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the PR and have the strongest recent history on the agent tool and macOS surfaces involved in the decision.
